visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and thick-rimmed black glasses, wearing a white t-shirt and a gold ring, sits indoors holding a small black wireless microphone. He is positioned in front of a large window overlooking a city with green mountains in the distance under bright natural daylight. A silver laptop is open on his lap. (2) A static graphic appears showing two grey charging port illustrations; the left one is labeled 'CCS2' and the right 'TYPE 2'. (3) The man returns to the frame, talking directly to the camera with high engagement. (4) An image of a black 'J1772 to TYPE2' charging adapter is shown against a white background, featuring a small black combination lock next to it. (5) A cartoon-style illustration depicts a row of green charging stations labeled 'J1772' in an outdoor setting with green hills. (6) A red Tesla Model Y is shown parked in a driveway, with a charging cable plugged into its rear port. (7) An image of a curved black 'TPC to TYPE2' adapter is displayed. (8) A cartoon illustration shows a charging post labeled 'TPC' at a campsite with a tent and trees. (9) A product shot shows a black JOWUA branded carrying case with various adapters inside. (10) A close-up shot shows a hand inserting a combination lock into a charging adapter plugged into a Tesla port. (11) A product shot of a 'CCS1 to CCS2' fast-charging adapter is shown. (12) A person holds a lighter and applies a flame to the casing of a black charging adapter to demonstrate its heat-resistant material properties. (13) A QR code for a LINE group chat titled '電動車 & 特斯拉 x 老爸討論群' appears on the screen.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 特斯拉車主該買什麼轉接頭. (2) [Subtitle]: 最近Model Y的交車潮. (3) [Subtitle]: 群組內很多人詢問. (4) [Subtitle]: 如果你對台灣的充電規格不瞭解. (5) [Subtitle]: 花個一分鐘瞭解一下. (6) [Subtitle]: 底下有影片的連結. (7) [Subtitle]: Model Y 是 CCS2 的規格. (8) [Subtitle]: 慢充是 TYPE 2. (9) [Subtitle]: 第一個你一定要買. (10) [Subtitle]: J1772 轉 TYPE 2. (11) [Subtitle]: 因為目前的公有停車場. (12) [Subtitle]: 還是有很多 J1772 的慢充. (13) [Subtitle]: 有這個轉接頭不是只有充電而已. (14) [Subtitle]: 有時候也會讓停車的選擇更多更彈性. (15) [Subtitle]: 接下來兩個就未必一定要買. (16) [Subtitle]: 其中一個是 TPC 轉 TYPE 2. (17) [Subtitle]: TPC 是特斯拉早期的規格. (18) [Subtitle]: 在一些酒店露營區還是會看到. (19) [Subtitle]: TPC 慢充大部分不用費用的. (20) [Subtitle]: 如果你的生活圈會出現我覺得一定要買. (21) [Subtitle]: 用個幾次就非常划算. (22) [Subtitle]: JOWUA 也有出捆包. (23) [Subtitle]: 裡面還有附一個鎖頭. (24) [Subtitle]: 防止充到一半被拔掉. (25) [Subtitle]: 我的折扣碼購買 95 折 <DADDY>. (26) [Subtitle]: 最後一個你可以考慮購買的是 CCS1 轉 CCS2 快充轉接頭. (27) [Subtitle]: 如果你常在尖峰時間快充. (28) [Subtitle]: 一定難免會遇到一個狀況就是 CCS2 的槍已經滿了. (29) [Subtitle]: 這時候不用排隊直接用 CCS1 轉接. (30) [Subtitle]: 時間最貴用個幾次就划算了. (31) [Subtitle]: 轉接頭用電大一點推薦買有品質的. (32) [Subtitle]: 可以掃碼加入老爸 LINE 社群.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A man in his 30s-40s with black hair and black glasses, wearing a simple white short-sleeved t-shirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Primary background is a high-rise indoor room with a floor-to-ceiling window showcasing a green mountain range and urban city buildings under a bright sky. Secondary backgrounds include product shots on plain white and digital illustrations.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice begins speaking in Mandarin with an energetic, helpful tone. The background music is a steady, upbeat acoustic pop track with bright guitar and a simple rhythmic beat. (2) A subtle digital 'whoosh' sound effects trigger during a visual transition to port graphics. The vocal remains consistent in speed and pitch. (3) A soft 'pop' SFX is heard as product images are introduced. The music continues in the background, providing a cheerful atmosphere. (4) The speaker's tone remains professional as he explains different standards. A light 'ding' sounds when a discount code is mentioned. (5) The track ends with a final vocal call to action and a slight fade in the background music.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Introduction of Standards -> Key Product Recommendation -> Optional Product Recommendations -> Promotion/Discount -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To educate new Tesla Model Y owners in Taiwan on which charging adapters are essential for public charging stations while promoting specific JOWUA brand products using a personal discount code.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The speaker explicitly mentions the brand 'JOWUA', displays their products, and provides a personal discount code 'DADDY' for a 5% discount.

high_inference.freeDescribe: This is a typical 'KOL' style promotional tutorial video aimed at the Taiwanese electric vehicle community. It combines high-density information with a fast-paced edit to maintain engagement.
